column1: # docs/r2_owners.tsv — who ports each row of the generated R2 status (docs/architecture.md): HAND-EDITED, never generated.
# key<TAB>owner step<TAB>note.  Keys: pred:name/N · flag:NAME · vmi:NAME · refusal:file::function::message (exact);
# cfile:<upstream C basename> = every pred and VM-instruction row of that C file without an exact key; kfile:<kernel file basename> = every refusal row of that kernel file.
# A missing or refused row without an owner prints NO OWNER in the status (information). An owner line whose key names no missing or refused row is R2-OWNER-STALE:
# a finished feature's row leaves the table, its porter removes the line. SEED (R2GEN): predicate owners from evidence/R2/missing_c_preds.tsv column 5 (the step after `NEW `;
# `Q10 stubs … rest NEW D3` → D3; `DEFER to LB5-LB7` → LB5-LB7; NONE → no owner); VM instructions by family; the QLF refusal sites → LB3; table_* flags → TAB1.
